title: FLASHING LIGHTS
lines: Flashing lights is a data center on the moon.
It keeps 1,282 shots from 64 films. Every film is a tower, every shot a floor, every frame a window.
Its 9 streets are the scenes of the poem, in order: the first is “Poet floats in black under flashes”.
The tallest tower is Friendship Seven (1962): 36 floors.
Nothing in it is older than 1927 or newer than 2017.
The sign most often read here is icon.
